actions.name: send_text_message
actions.description: Send a text message to a chat, group or channel.

actions.name: send_media
actions.description: Send a photo, video, sticker or GIF to a chat.

actions.name: send_document
actions.description: Send any file to a chat as a document.

actions.name: send_audio
actions.description: Send an MP3 or M4A file that plays in Telegram's music player.

actions.name: send_location
actions.description: Send a map pin, or a live location that updates, to a chat.

actions.name: send_media_group
actions.description: Send 2 to 10 photos, videos, files or audio tracks as one album.

actions.name: send_poll
actions.description: Send a poll or a quiz to a chat.

actions.name: send_chat_action
actions.description: Show a status like "typing…" in a chat for up to 5 seconds.

actions.name: edit_message_text
actions.description: Replace the text of a message the bot sent.

actions.name: delete_message
actions.description: Delete a message. The bot needs admin rights to delete other people's messages.

actions.name: forward_message
actions.description: Forward a message from one chat to another.

actions.name: pin_message
actions.description: Pin a message. The bot must be an admin in the chat.

actions.name: unpin_message
actions.description: Unpin one message, or the most recent pinned message.

actions.name: get_chat
actions.description: Get a chat's title, type, description and settings.

actions.name: get_chat_member
actions.description: Get a person's status and permissions in a chat.

actions.name: get_file
actions.description: Get file details and, optionally, its content.

actions.name: create_invite_link
actions.description: Create an invite link for a group or channel.

actions.name: answer_callback_query
actions.description: Answer a tap on an inline button with a short banner or alert.

actions.name: request_approval_message
actions.description: Send an approval message to a chat and wait until the message is approved or disapproved

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_telegram_message
triggers.description: Triggers when the bot receives a Telegram update (message, callback query, poll answer, etc.).
